claims.head: The Ducks’ edge in the penalty kill
claims.body: The Ducks are around the middle of the league for the penalty kill, and the Canucks are the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one. Anaheim’s penalty kill has been near the bottom of the league for years, though.
